name: Nkisi Attunement
body:
Prerequisite(s): Nganga level 6th, Craft (fetishes) 6 ranks

Benefit(s): Choose one of your nkisi. You can activate that nkisi’s power as a swift action instead of a standard action.

Additionally, the saving throw DC for that nkisi’s effects increases by 2.

Special: You can select this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a different nkisi.
